title: HomeGuardian: Detecting Anomaly Events in Smart Home Systems
review_status: citation/topic follow-up full-text audit complete; not a direct IoTGaze replication
sections_checked: per-device anomaly F1 table and headline comparison
venue_year_verified: Wireless Communications and Mobile Computing (2022), DOI 10.1155/2022/8022033.
evidence_note: Home Assistant testbed combines real and virtual devices (virtual activity partly based on CASAS HH114); forged sensor-event attacks are simulated. Chronological 80/20 split. Abstract says F1 >.90 for all device types, but extracted per-device table includes temporal-only F1 .33-.91 and malformed HTML column labels require PDF verification before attributing a single summary score. Authors report raw event intervals vary randomly and can spike with outages, limiting interval-only detection. Different input/modality from IoTGaze; not a replication.

title: PrivacyGuard: Exploring Hidden Cross-App Privacy Leakage Threats In IoT Apps
review_status: citation/topic follow-up primary proceedings page and artifact-status audit complete; full numerical tables not adjudicated in this pass
sections_checked: PoPETs 2025 official proceedings metadata and abstract
dataset sizes and reported chain leakage rate
evidence_note: Official proceedings abstract reports evaluation on 2,101 SmartApps, 2,788 IFTTT rules and 2,086 OpenHAB rules; 7.67% of constructed two-app chains could leak a privacy category, with >80% of leaks involving localization/tracking or activity profiling. Proceedings badge says artifact Available, Functional, Reproduced; this is artifact evaluation, not independent scientific replication. Distinct outcome and pipeline from IoTGaze; detailed tables and denominators remain queued for full audit.
